artboards.title: Record Sources — the census line and ONE Inventory door per source (five states)
View sample — one document of a grouping, with the label set
Associate — recognition, AI suggestion, human decision
Inventory Information — a data system (kinds and fields)
Inventory Information — never censused: where the first census is started
No redaction needed — the confirmation (a release decision, checked and recorded)

annotations.text: DECIDED 2026-09-04 (three rounds) and drawn here: census runs PER SOURCE, one at a time, as a background job with progress · per-source Inventory Information (totals · readable / needs-OCR / unsupported · file types · identical groupings with counts + redaction-template status · linked types · last census + incremental diff) · documents = fingerprint groupings + layouts, data systems = kind enumeration + render recipes · embed tiers (kind description always · prose rows opt-in with cost · never pure id/date/number kinds) · field-REDACTED renderings (the field redaction template applied first) are what embed · 'Identical Grouping' is the name (nav 'Find Same-Format Records' renamed in this build) · OCR-then-census for scanned files — automatic, local tesseract, the census's SECOND PASS (Kevin 2026-09-15: no opt-in, no fee; text-layer files first so groupings appear early) · every file type counted, unreadables reported, never skipped. Kevin's 2026-09-13 add: a button to view a snapshot of an actual document / rendered record — drawn as 'View sample' and 'View a rendered record'.

FROM THE FLOW MAP (item 5, DESIGN_setup_flow_map.md), drawn on the assumption Kevin confirms it: the census needs NO record type linked (a bare drive can be censused); association happens over GROUPINGS, recognition first, then one AI naming call, and a HUMAN approval writes the type↔source link, the fingerprint stamps, the draft variant and the signature — nothing before. 'Find variants' on the Taxonomy page keeps its modal but reads this census store; the Scan source page (/discovery) retires. Sub-folders are walked; the folder path is shown as a hint under each grouping (decision 4), not used as a grouping rule.

DECIDED (Kevin, 2026-09-14 late): ONE 'Inventory' door per source card — the first census, its progress and every refresh live inside the Inventory screen (drawn: InventoryEmpty for a never-censused source; Refresh census on the censused ones). 'Everything else' is just a FILE LIST — no screen of its own (drawn expanded inline under the row). DECIDED (Kevin, 2026-09-15): a grouping without a redaction template has THREE doors — Start a redaction template · Redact by hand (the old Mass Redaction dismiss, honestly named: each request's copies reviewed one by one) · No redaction needed (Kevin's ask: a RELEASE decision written to the variant — public availability Releasable + auto-release on — guarded by the bucket's legal gate and availability, a required reason, the redaction-config role bar, and the existing clean-read guardrail: only a read that finds nothing releases as-is). DECIDED (Kevin, 2026-09-15): OCR is not opt-in — it is the census's second pass, local and free; the 'Run OCR' button and the dollar figure were a drawing error and are gone. STILL OPEN: (d) for search-only systems (Laserfiche) the card says plainly that no census is possible — acceptable until their APIs are wired?

COST AND SAFETY, as drawn: the census itself is model-free (hashing, text extraction, fingerprinting) — OCR is local tesseract (time, not money); the only paid step is one small naming call per unrecognised grouping at association time. Row-level embedding of a data kind is gated on its field redaction template existing (sequence: census → field redaction template → embed). Nothing on this screen releases a record; it is setup, gated like Record Sources today (System Admin / Director).

TEMPLATES, named (Kevin, 2026-09-15): every template on these screens is a REDACTION template — a zone (layout) redaction template for a document grouping, a FIELD redaction template for a data kind. ESTIMATE templates (item 7: estimate + redaction templates seeded from actual record samples at 'done') are NOT on these screens yet; when item 7 is designed, the grouping row would gain a second status column for the estimate template. 'No redaction needed' is therefore not a template either: it is a posture on the variant that the existing record-type-clean bypass already honours.
